scientific_integrity: Proof by exact two-step transfer and strict Schur criterion; 5000 rational checks are consistency tests only. Theoretical result requires independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Only scalar, shared-minimizer, positive-curvature, two-component fixed cyclic ordering and 0 <= beta < 1. No extensions to arbitrary schedule, multidimensional Hessians, or noise. Earlier equivalent specialized treatments remain a literature risk.
title: A sharp disconnected stability diagram for cyclic two-component heavy-ball descent
